what: Exchange contract-grid facts used by the sizing calculators: index derivative lot sizes and the equity tick-size bands. Both are DATED tables, never constants — NSE has revised index lots roughly half-yearly (the Jan-2026 series cut NIFTY from 75 to 65) and the tick grid changed on 10 Jun 2024. Each revision carries its own effectiveFrom so a calculation made for a past date uses the grid that applied on that date, and the UI can state which revision it used.

indexLotRevisions.label: Jan-2026 series
indexLotRevisions.driver: SEBI contract-value band of Rs 15-20 lakh

indexLotRevisions.label: pre Jan-2026 series
indexLotRevisions.note: The superseded grid, kept so a calculation dated before the Jan-2026 series resolves the lot that actually applied then.
